children: Tenax reported LEVEL topline and comprehensive results showing ~49% NT-proBNP reduction and a 3.5 mmHg decline in RVSP, while the trial missed its primary 6MWD endpoint.
LEVEL did not meet primary Δ6MWD at 12 weeks (placebo-adjusted LS mean 3.5 m; p=0.63), but subgroup benefits observed.
NT-proBNP fell ~49% vs placebo at Week 12 (geometrics LS mean ratio 0.51; p < 0.0001), consistent across early visits.
RV systolic pressure declined 3.5 mmHg vs placebo (week‑12 median change; p≈0.0045), aligning with biomarker improvements.
Patients with baseline 6MWD <333 m showed a prespecified +26.3 m placebo-adjusted Δ6MWD (95% CI 6.0,46.7; nominal p=0.0112).
Safety: higher treatment‑related AEs, dose reductions and discontinuations on TNX-103 (headache, palpitations, hypotension); serious AEs and clinical worsening balanced.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
